slides.0.title: White grape varieties
slides.0.subtitle: Chardonnay, Riesling, Pinot Gris and more
slides.1.title: Oregon's whites
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Pinot Gris
slides.1.highlights.0.content: About 6,483 acres in 2024, roughly 14% of Oregon's planted area and its most important white variety
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Chardonnay
slides.1.highlights.1.content: About 3,482 acres in 2024, roughly 7%; with Pinot Noir it is an important variety in the Willamette Valley
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Where the figures come from
slides.1.highlights.2.content: These come from the Oregon Wine Board's 2024 census; percentages are approximations calculated from the acreage
slides.1.content: Oregon's whites are led by Pinot Gris, then Chardonnay, both suited to the cool Willamette Valley.
slides.2.title: Washington's Riesling
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Riesling's standing
slides.2.highlights.0.content: In 2024 Riesling made up about 15% of the state's crush (22,168 tons), second only to Cabernet Sauvignon and first among whites
slides.2.highlights.1.title: Eroica
slides.2.highlights.1.content: From 1999 Chateau Ste. Michelle collaborated with Germany's Dr. Loosen on Eroica Riesling
slides.2.highlights.2.title: Share of whites
slides.2.highlights.2.content: In 2024 whites were 45% of the crush and reds 55%
slides.2.content: Riesling is the centre of Washington's whites, at about one and a half tenths of the crush.
slides.3.title: New York's Riesling and other varieties
slides.3.highlights.0.title: Finger Lakes Riesling
slides.3.highlights.0.content: Riesling is seen as New York's most consistently high-quality vinifera; the Finger Lakes had about 832 acres in 2024, and the average producer makes 2 to 3 styles a year
slides.3.highlights.1.title: Concord and American varieties
slides.3.highlights.1.content: Concord is a Vitis labrusca variety that dominates New York's grape area; Catawba is an important American hybrid
slides.3.highlights.2.title: Variety families
slides.3.highlights.2.content: Vinifera (European), labrusca (American) and hybrids are the three families for understanding East Coast varieties
slides.3.content: The East Coast adds a layer: beyond vinifera there are American and hybrid varieties.
Which is Oregon's most important white variety?
Which variety ranked second in Washington's 2024 crush?
Riesling, about 15% (22,168 tons), behind only Cabernet Sauvignon.
Concord is a Vitis labrusca variety.
Eroica Riesling is a collaboration between which two?
A. Chateau Ste. Michelle and Dr. Loosen
